description: These functions allocate nodes for values and binary operators, then print part of a tree recursively.

steps.description: The implementation includes C libraries and the AST declarations.
ast_num and ast_var allocate a node, set its kind, and store the supplied value or copied name.
ast_binop creates a binary-operation node with an operator and two child pointers.
ast_print indents each node. A binary operation prints itself and then recursively prints its left and right children.

title: Create and print AST nodes
